breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature; at 100°C water vapor pressure is near atmospheric, so Hv is about 10.3 m, not 0.3 m.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the physically inconsistent value for the vapor pressure head (Hv). The ground truth corrects Hv to be approximately 10.3 m, consistent with water at 100°C. The agent, however, used the incorrect value of Hv = 0.3 m from the original prompt in its calculation, thereby failing to resolve the inconsistency.
